sources: FAA NASR 28-day subscription, cycle effective 2026-10-01; NAV_CSV, ILS_CSV, FIX_CSV zips (https://nfdc.faa.gov/webContent/28DaySub/extra/01_Oct_2026_<NAME>_CSV.zip)

_provenance.method: Extracted by scripts/extract-nasr-airport.ts PGD KPGD. ILS rows with ARPT_ID == PGD; navaids named in kpgd-procedures.json navaids_referenced; fixes = every 5-letter fix named in fixes_and_roles of an instrument approach and every fix of a STAR transcription (stars[].star) in that file (each also checked against NASR FIX_BASE and, in charted_on, FIX_CHRT).

primary_navaid.name: LEE COUNTY
remarks: VOR UNUSBL 025-040 BYD 40 NM; 075-095 BYD 40 NM; 110-116 BYD 40 NM; 117-127 BYD 40 NM BLW 2300 FT; 117-127 BYD 57 NM.
primary_navaid.location_note: There is NO navaid at PGD in NASR (no NAV_BASE row named for the airport; the ILS DME is the airport's own DME source). The ILS 4 plate and the 4 and 33 RNAV plates use the LEE COUNTY VORTAC (RSW, 114.15, chan 88Y, 26.52988669 N 81.7757685 W, NASR status OPERATIONAL RESTRICTED, variation 2W epoch 1985) about 24 NM south-southwest of the airport as IAF / feeder and for the plate distances (computed from the NASR coordinates, not an FAA-published figure).

ils_localizers.note: One ILS exists: runway 4 (I-PGD 109.75, ILS/DME channel 34Y, GS 333.05, category I, NASR ILS_BASE system type LD, status OPERATIONAL IFR, remarks 'ILS CLASSIFICATION CODE IA' and 'ILS UNMON WHEN ATCT CLSD'). Runways 22, 15 and 33 have no ILS or LOC (RNAV (GPS) only); runway 9/27 has no approach. NASR lists no marker beacons.

systems.system_type_meaning: LD = localizer with DME (NASR code; plates say LOC/DME and ILS/DME)
systems.marker_beacons: none listed in ILS_MKR.csv for PGD

plate_data.plate_minima: ILS or LOC RWY 4 (Amdt 1 05SEP24): S-ILS 4 DA 256 ft, HAT 232 (300-3/4), all categories. GS 3.00 deg, TCH 50 (plate). S-LOC 4: Cat A-B MDA 480 HAT 456 (500-1); Cat C-D 480-1 3/8 (500-1 3/8); with ISOXE fix (DME required) MDA 380 HAT 356 (400-1).

unverified: Fix roles are human-read from the plate images; verify against the PDFs before safety-critical use.
The LEE COUNTY VORTAC (RSW) is 'OPERATIONAL RESTRICTED' in NAV_BASE with variation 2W (epoch 1985).

VIOLA, PINTS and ROGAN are reporting points (NASR FIX_USE RP) on the plates; their 'feeder route' roles are read from the plan view arrows and were checked numerically against the NASR coordinates (distance and track to ZEPIG / OWGAF / BRUSK / SACRA).
